mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread: a poster says King main thrust bearings made since 2024 (sold repackaged as Engine Tech 7.3 IDI mains) have a free-spread problem and a machinist judged one out of spec; the poster concedes it may not cause issues in practice.
